subject: *: avoid some unnecessary call of ensureActiveUser() (#57388)
summary: Removes several non-essential ensureActiveUser()-triggering paths by (1) reading mysql.user.authentication_string directly in SHOW CREATE USER instead of going through privilege cache, (2) short-circuiting per-target dynamic privilege checks when executor already has sufficient dynamic privileges, and (3) using existing mysql.user reads (userExistsInternal) to obtain auth plugin for ALTER USER / SET PASSWORD instead of privilege-manager GetAuthPlugin; drops Manager.GetEncodedPassword accordingly.
